# r129 — actual installed Tabliss parents

**Both actual-parent endpoint sequences are independently supported.** The original r125 failures remain unchanged. Chromium imports through the installed extension's settings UI, then reads the exact two imported `storage.sync` keys before closing the importing tab. Ten reads showed the initial mismatch and exact persistence after 992.523193359375 ms. A fresh extension-owned tab and parent reload retain the 325×530 widget. This supports the missing persistence-precondition hypothesis; it does not prove the historical failure's unique cause.

Firefox uses the installed `Capture.sys.mjs` original framebuffer route, already available in the isolated native harness, instead of the unsupported initial screenshot command. All seven readbacks verify the selected extension parent and image geometry. No personal profile or desktop is accessed. Original iframe raster softness remains a capture limitation; no fine text/colour or cross-engine fidelity claim is made.

Both engines show admitted cloud35 weather, current refined content and six intact timetable rows. Native settings switch glass → contrast → glass, and parent reload preserves glass. Independent inspection of all eight mode/reload whole-parent PNGs confirms visually distinct faded glass and opaque contrast rows, intact weather and footer. Recorded target, weather and generation remain unchanged by the settings switches. Celsius/Fahrenheit fixtures differ intentionally between engines.

[Independent review](../reviews/parents-r129-native-result-review-r1.json), [Chromium result](chromium/results.json), [Firefox result](firefox/RESULT.json) and [publication inventory](../PUBLICATION-r128-r129.json) bind original pixels and exact inputs. This closes the missing admitted-weather/mode/reload parent sequence at endpoint scope. It does not certify cold startup, uninterrupted motion, complete transition-duration behavior or callback cost. Browser resources were released after each serial case.
